questions.question: A sum at simple interest becomes two times in 8 years at a certain rate of interest p.a. The time in which the same sum will be 4 times at the same rate of interest at simple interest is:
questions.solution:
**Formula used:**

A = P(1 + RT/100)

A → Amount

P → Principal

R → Rate 

T → Time

**Calculation:**

A sum at simple interest becomes two times in 8 years

⇒ 2P = P(1 + 8R/100)

⇒ R = 100/8

⇒ R = 12.5

∴ The rate of interest is 12.5%

The time in which the same sum will be 4 times

⇒ 4P = P(1 + 12.5 × T)/100

⇒ 300 = 12.5T

⇒ T = 24 

**∴ The sum will be 4 times in 24 years**

questions.question: If a³ + b³ = 62 and a + b = 2, then the value of ab is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

a + b = 2

a3 + b3 = 62

**Formula used:**

(a + b)³ = a3 + b3 + 3ab(a + b)

**Calculation:**

a + b = 2

Cubing the given equation

(a + b)³ = 2³

⇒ a³ + b³ + 3ab(a + b) = 8

⇒ 62 + 3ab (2) = 8 

⇒ 6ab = 8 – 62

⇒ 6ab = -54

⇒ ab = -54/6 = -9

**∴ The value of ab is -9.**

questions.question: The areas of three adjacent faces of a cuboid are 30 cm², 20 cm² and 24 cm². The volume of the cuboid is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Area of three adjacent faces of a cuboid are 30 cm2, 20 cm2, and 24 cm2

**Formula used:**

Area of rectangle = length × breadth

Volume of cuboid = length × breadth × height

**Calculation:**

Area of three adjacent faces of cuboid are lb, bh, lh

where l → Length of cuboid

b → Breadth of cuboid

h → Height of cuboid

According to question,

lb = 30, bh = 20, lh = 24

Now, lb/bh = 30/20

⇒ l/h = 3/2

⇒ l = (3/2) × h ----(i)

lh = 24 ----(ii)

Putting value of l from (i) in (ii)

(3/2) × h × h = 24

⇒ h² = 16 

⇒ h = 4 cm

l = (3/2) × 4 = 6 cm

b = 30/6 = 5 cm

Volume of cuboid = lbh = 6 × 5 × 4 = 120 cm³.

∴ Volume of cuboid is 120 cm3.

questions.question: When a number is divided by 14, the remainder is 9. If the square of the same number is divided by 14, then the remainder will be:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A number, when divided by 14, leaves a remainder of 9

**Calculation:**

Suppose the number is = 14 + 9 = 23

Now, the square of the number is divided by 14

⇒ 23²/14 = 529

⇒ 529/14 leaves a remainder is 11

**∴ The remainder will be 11.**

questions.question: On selling 26 balls for Rs. 1,350, there is a loss equal to the cost price of eight balls. The cost price of a ball is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Selling Price = Rs. 1350

**Calculation:**

Let the cost price of one ball be x

Now selling 26 balls for Rs. 1,350, there is a loss equal to the cost price of eight balls

Cost price of 26 balls = 26x, loss = 8x(8 balls)

Loss = Cost Price – Selling Price

⇒ 8x = 26x – 1350

⇒ 18x = 1350

⇒ x = 75 

**∴ The cost price of a ball is Rs.75**

questions.question: The speed of a train is 220% of the speed of a car. The car covers a distance of 950 km in 19 hours. How much distance will the train cover in 3.5 hours?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Distance = 950 km

Time = 19 hours

**Formula used:**

Speed = Distance/Time

**Calculation:**

Speed of car = 950/19 = 50 km/hr

Speed of train = (220/100) × 50 = 110 km/hr

Now, distance covered by train in 3.5 hrs

Distance = 110 × 3.5 = 385 km

**∴ The correct answer is option (2).**

For 1st half = (x/2) × (1/20) = x/40

For second half C and D together work

C and D working together = (1/15 + 1/20) = 7/60

For second half = (x/2) × (7/60) = 7x/120

⇒ 10x/120 = 1

questions.question: A is twice as good a workman as B and together they finish a piece of work in 22 days. In how many days will A alone finish the same work?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A is twice as good as B

Time is taken to finish work = 22 days

**Calculation:**

A is twice as good as B

A can complete the given work in half time of B

Suppose B can complete work in 2x days

Then, A can complete the work in 2x/2 = x days

According to the question.

⇒ (1/x) + (1/2x) = 1/22

⇒ (1 + 2)/2x = 1/22

⇒ 3/2x = 1/22

⇒ x = 33 days

**∴ A alone can finish the given work in 33 days**

questions.question: If √x = √3 - √5, then the value of x² - 16x + 6 is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

√x = √3 – √ 5

**Calculation:**

Squaring both sides

(√x)² = (√3 – √5)²

⇒ x = 3 + 5 – 2√15 

⇒ x – 8 = -2√15

Again, squaring both sides

(x – 8)² = (-2√15)²

⇒ x² + 64 – 16x = 4 × 15

⇒ x² + 4 – 16x = 0

⇒ x² – 16x + 6 = 2 

**∴ The value is 2.**

questions.question: If the price of an eraser is reduced by 25%, a person can buy three more erasers for Rs. 2. How many erasers can be bought for Rs. 2 as the original price ?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Let the cost price of one eraser be Rs.x

The number of erasers bought by the person in Rs.2 be y 

Expenditure = Price × consumption

⇒ 2 = x × y ----(i)

The price of an eraser is reduced by 25%, a person can buy three more erasers for Rs.2

⇒ 2 = (75x / 100) × (y + 3) ----(ii)

Equating (i) and (ii)

⇒ xy = (3x / 4) × (y + 3)

⇒ 4y = 3y + 9

⇒ y = 9

**∴ The total number of erasers that can be bought for the original price is 9.**
